c24_host_checks.scope: Compare all named constant arrays; execute production host wrappers and coverage tests on CPU. Host instruction equality is not claimed.

cross_gpu.scope: B300 14 October versus B200 15 October; numeric records only, one key per routine/shape/effective width/distribution/seed/input SHA; repeated calls and engine variants with the same key are grouped, with all output hashes required to agree. Historical GPU-generated inputs use a different hash scheme and are excluded. No large records from the old B200 run are merged in.

strmm_scope: 23-bit, dyadic 16 and 17 cubed. CPU checks and B200 execution exercised the shared host path including triangular input preparation. K96 device code matches libraries previously run on B300. The corrected B300 frontend was not run again.
evidence_editing: The measurement-source link uses its current public filename. Numeric fields, settings and hashes are unchanged. Worker JSON SHA values refer to the original records.
